paper.title_en: CHARMS250V1: A Cryogenic Front-End ASIC for Low-Noise Readout of Charge or Light Signals in Noble Liquid Detectors
paper.abstract_en: This work presents the design and measurement results of CHARMS250V1, a next-generation cryogenic front-end application specific integrated circuit (ASIC) developed using a 65 nm CMOS process. It is designed for low-noise readout of charge or light signals generated in noble liquid detectors. CHARMS250V1 is a single channel prototype whose design in the future will be integrated within a 16-channel ASIC. It comprises pre-amplification and pulse shaping stages that provide programmable charge gain between 4.3 mV/fC and 25 mV/fC, peaking time programmable between 250 ns and 2 us, and programmable baseline of either 200 mV or 900 mV for processing of unipolar and bipolar signals, respectively.
